### Added
- **The chart provisions Agent Substrate's snapshot store on CAPA** (giantswarm/agent-platform#411, giantswarm/giantswarm#37705 wave 1e): `kagent.harness.snapshotStore.crossplane` renders the S3 `Bucket` (lifecycle expiration `aws.lifecycleDays`, 30 days by default; public-access block; TLS-only policy; never deleted by Crossplane, kept by Helm) and the IAM `Role` trusted by Substrate's `atelet` and `ate-api-server` ServiceAccounts in `ate-system` through the installation's IRSA OIDC provider, the way `postgres.backup.crossplane` renders the kagent-pg backup bucket (the Crossplane helpers and the bucket/trust/policy partials are shared: `agent-platform.crossplane.*`). The meta chart derives `kagent.harness.snapshotLocation` = `s3://<aws.bucketName>/<prefix>` for the kagent release (an explicit value that differs fails the render naming both keys), holds the block back from the kagent chart (`components.kagent.omitKeys` takes dotted paths), and forwards the role's ARN as `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` on the substrate release's `atelet.serviceAccount.annotations` and `ateApiServer.serviceAccount.annotations` (Substrate `0.0.27-gs.8`; a differing explicit role fails the render, an installation's other annotations stay). Off by default; `make verify-substrate-store`, `ci/test-substrate-store-aws-values.yaml`; UPGRADE.md.
